title: AI StoryBuilders 4.0
subtitle: Quick Start
text: This is the quick start for AI StoryBuilders 4.0. It runs as a Windows app and in your web browser, with the same screens in both.

label: Connect an AI provider
text: First, open Settings and connect an AI provider: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, or Ollama. The app tests each model before you can use it.

label: Create a story
text: To start a story, click New Story. Enter a title and a short synopsis, choose how many chapters you want, and click Create Story.

label: The story workspace
text: The AI drafts the characters, locations, timelines and chapters, and opens the story workspace. Each part of the story has its own tab.

label: Refine the details
text: Click Edit next to any character, location or timeline to refine it. The AI uses these details to keep your story consistent.

label: Write with AI
text: To write, open a section, describe what should happen, and click Generate.

label: Review the result
text: The new text appears in the editor. If you don't like it, click Undo to get your words back.

label: Story Chat
text: The Chat tab answers questions about your story and can propose changes, like a new character. Nothing is saved until you click Apply.

label: Knowledge Base
text: The Knowledgebase tab holds your own reference notes, which the AI can search while it writes.

label: Your writing voice
text: On the Details tab, Writing Voice lets the AI write in your own style. When you're ready, save your story as a Word document.
